card.name: Linking words before drug names or lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or an opening parenthesis (of, or, including, containing, '(') right before a drug name, study list or section number in drug-label text.

modes.label: Open parenthesis before a list
modes.description: An opening bracket that begins a list of studies or drug components.

modes.label: Linking word before a drug name
modes.description: Words like of, or, including placed right before a named product or drug.
modes.example: patients treated with HCV NS3/4A protease inhibitor-containing regimens,<< including>> MAVYRET.
